key.name: toggle-launcher
key.description: Keybinding to open/close the launcher popup. Defaults to Ctrl+Alt+Space to avoid colliding with GNOME's own Super+Space (input source switcher).

key.name: icon-scale
key.description: Multiplier applied to every icon size across all layouts. 1.0 is the default size.

key.name: background-opacity
key.description: Opacity of launcher backgrounds (1.0 opaque, 0.0 fully transparent). Lower values let Blur My Shell blur show through. Applies to all layouts.

key.name: dim-background
key.description: Whether to dim the screen behind the launcher.

key.name: theme-file-path
key.description: Absolute path to a CSS file containing Material 3 color roles as custom properties (--surface: #hex;, --primary: #hex;, etc.). Leave empty to use the built-in purple fallback scheme.

key.name: wallpaper-path
key.description: Absolute path to a wallpaper image used by hero-banner and split-tabs layouts. Leave empty to try ~/.config/background.jpg automatically, or skip wallpaper if none is found.
